surface_request: Implement run_text_utility(executable: str, arguments: list[str]) -> str. Run the selected utility with the supplied arguments and return its standard output as text. Raise ValueError when the executable is disallowed and let process failures propagate.
plan:
The implementation must enforce the fixed executable policy by permitting only the literal path /usr/bin/printf. Immediately upon entry, compare the provided executable parameter to exactly this string. If the value is anything other than /usr/bin/printf, raise ValueError before any further action. When the executable is accepted, launch it using a process-spawning facility that treats the arguments parameter as a direct vector passed to the new process image, and explicitly ensure that command-interpreter or shell processing is disabled so that no argument string is interpreted by a shell. Capture the child process's standard output. Decode the captured output bytes into a text string using a standard text encoding such as UTF-8, and return that string. Do not intercept, wrap, or suppress exceptions arising from process execution failures or non-zero exit statuses; allow them to propagate naturally to the caller.
END_PLAN
